method: Explicit absolute system executables, same argv from a shared specification except the marked glob-expansion difference; Execute explain verifies argv and separate traces verify native spawn identities/count. Bash files use shlex quoting except that glob test, with no startup hooks or builtin applets. NUL-framed native printf independently checks adversarial argv transport. Exact exit/stdout/stderr per case, independent expected output where supplied; otherwise Bash is the byte oracle. Marked failure cases check distinct expected status/diagnostic/output contracts. Traces and explain are excluded from timed observations. Owned fixtures only, minimal environment, one-entry unused catalog (not the normal project catalog), 8s/1MiB per invocation. Sequential seeded interleaved pairs, warm filesystem, fresh processes; requested warmups excluded from summaries but retained. Timing includes Python spawn/capture/exit and runner overhead. Descriptive per-case observations only; no general speedup, isolated interpreter/pipe latency, normal-catalog startup, cold-cache, Arch/Omarchy desktop acceptance, 100 distinct commands, held-out script/model, full-replacement or score claim.
